topic: Học từ vựng tiếng Anh LOYAL (tính từ: thuỷ chung) qua câu chuyện và ngữ cảnh thực tế
audience: English learners at B1 and above learning one vocabulary sense through clear situations and explanatory pictures.
goal: Người xem hiểu đúng nghĩa "thuỷ chung" của từ LOYAL, nhớ lâu và biết đặt câu tự nhiên

required_points.text: Open with a concrete situation or central question that makes the selected word useful.
Explain the selected meaning in accessible English and show the defining action or relationship.
Use correct linked example sentences; explain relevant grammar within the situation.
Provide a clear spoken model for pronunciation; practice only when useful to the job.
Return to and answer the opening question, giving an observable understanding or usage opportunity.

tone: Absurd, silly, completely fictional comedy set in a feudal Chinese imperial court; clear accessible English.
style: Layered cut-out animation (prompt registry 1.2.0): one empty background plate per scene plus anonymous stick-figure stickers on flat white, matted and animated with spring motion; imperial Chinese palace setting with red pillars, golden roofs, lanterns; no mascot, no main character.

success_criteria: Explain and use the selected sense of loyal in an appropriate English sentence.
The question, action/diagram and payoff serve the same selected sense.
Learning and retention effects are not measured without real learners.
Người xem không lẫn LOYAL với các nghĩa khác của chính từ này
avoid: Photorealistic or textured natural-history painting and dark cinematic lighting
Mandatory four-act comedy, six beats, meme twist, fixed repeat/image quotas or automatic Foley
Importing prehistoric topics as a required niche
Reading lesson headings as disconnected definitions/pronunciation/grammar items
Changing the selected sense, voice, character style or requested duration silently
Adding a recurring main character, presenter or narrator figure to scenes
Từ "loyal" còn nghĩa khác: trung thành [adj, loyal.adj.loyal-basic]. Video này KHÔNG dạy nghĩa đó.
planning.prior_knowledge: Basic English sentence comprehension; explain the chosen B1+ word using simpler words without teaching additional senses.
planning.pacing: Causal visual changes following spoken meaning; allow each actual sentence or diagram enough reading time. No fixed cut or image-count quota.
domain_requirements: Narration and learner-facing text are entirely English; explain meaning, usage and relevant grammar/pronunciation inside the same situation.
One central question or situation develops through cause, action and consequence and receives a payoff.
Use story shots, close action and diagrams where they prove meaning; preserve camera/background with Base reference for state changes.
Scene/image/beat counts are chosen for this specific script and saved before narration anchors; no universal scene count.

No recurring protagonist, presenter or host: each scene uses only the anonymous stick figures, animals or objects its action needs, identified by costume/props; keep a figure's costume consistent across Base-reference variations.
Từ khoá duy nhất của video: LOYAL (adj), chỉ dạy nghĩa "thuỷ chung"
Mức độ người học: CEFR B2; chủ đề: Gia đình và quan hệ
Mã mục trong kho từ vựng: loyal.adj (dùng để đánh dấu đã làm)
Use accessible English throughout. Internal bank gloss_vi is sense-selection data, not Vietnamese narration.
assumptions: Initial planning window, adjustable per job before narration. Not a measurement or a claim about the reference channel.
Scene/image counts are chosen per outline, not inherited from a global template.
Speech timing is estimated until the real WAV is collected.

text_style.outline: High contrast against a bright clear background
text_style.size: Readable on a phone, at most two meaningful caption lines
text_style.placement: Near the referent for teaching text; keep separate from captions
